name: Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojana — Graduation Incentive (Bihar)
description: Bihar Education Department incentive for an unmarried girl who has passed her graduation from a recognised university or college in Bihar. You must be a Bihar domicile. Apply online on the Medhasoft portal when the window opens, and your college must have sent your result to the portal. NOTE: sources disagree on the amount (most say ₹50,000; one says ₹25,000), on the portal address (medhasoft.bihar.gov.in or medhasoft.bih.nic.in) and on helpline numbers. Confirm everything on the official portal before you press Verify. The 31 Oct 2026 date quoted by one site is not confirmed, so no deadline is set.
benefits: One-time cash incentive paid by DBT to your bank account (reported ₹50,000; confirm the current amount).
required_documents: Aadhaar and bank account in your name
